name: wardalert
description: BMC Emergency Flood Operations and Risk Prediction System for Ward G/South, Mumbai

scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); console.log('Starting WardAlert API server on port 8000...'); const api = spawn('node', ['standalone_api.js'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Starting WardAlert Next.js frontend on port 3000...'); const fe = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { api.kill(); fe.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: WardAlert Team
